events.title: Demo Update 0.7 + Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: It's Steam Next Fest time and Folder Dungeon is part of it! I've also been working hard on the full version and I've made many good changes to the game, so decided to bundle them all into one big patch! Balance changes, visual improvements, more QoL features and more! 🙂 GENERAL CHANGES: - Bugs now show how much damage they will deal after defense reduction - Big improvements to relic animation clarity and consistent speed - Visually changed stat shards to candy (true OGs remember candies) - Offe

events.title: Demo Patch 0.6
events.summary: BUG FIXES: - Fixed a bug that caused game being broken for new players

events.title: Demo Patch 0.5
events.summary: - Fixed Alchemist class passive and P0TION add-on not duplicating modded relics correctly- Fixed performance issues for players that have a lot of runs in run history

events.title: Demo Patch 0.4
events.summary: NEW FEATURES:- Added run history!- Now you can find notes in the dungeon that give good tips! GENERAL CHANGES:- Changed "cooldown" keyword to just "cool" to reduce confusion BUG FIXES:- Fixed alchemy glove softlocking the game if it had "on potion use" trigger- Fixed few minor visual bugs

events.title: Demo Patch 0.3

events.title: Demo Patch 0.2

When? July 24th! (yup, this Friday!) This will be the end of public playtest too. Some important info: - Demo version will be the same as playtest one, so I won't be removing any content- Playtest progress will carry over to demo- This will probably the last playtest patch! events.title: Playtest Patch 0.0.7
events.summary: - Fixed bugs sometimes not showing that they are about to attack- Class victory count is back- :MYSTERY add-on no longer can give you error relic- Fixed inspecting mods and tarot cards not showing related relics- Fixed few minor visual bugs

events.title: Playtest Patch 0.0.6
events.summary: Starting to work on difficulty system, but first I need to tweak the add-on system a bit.Basically, upcoming difficulty system will require you to pick a bad modifier at the start of each zone. I think it will introduce a lot of variety to the runs, but it would also make the start of a run feel too slow. You'd need to pick a class, select an add-on pack and then a difficulty modifier. That's way too many decisions and clicking to get a run going, so that's why I'm tweaking how add-ons work.GENE

events.title: Playtest Patch 0.0.5

For example, if you inspect frost staff (on dealing arcane damage, apply frost) you can quickly look up which relics you have deal arcane damage- Added sliders to adjust game's saturation and brightness in color palette window- Resource collection effects are slightly animated- Improved zip open visual effectsBUG FIXES:- Fixed lance visual effects- Fixed enchanted cloak visual effects ---------
